title: Describing Objects and Functions
summary: Describing what products do, how they work, and recommending them.
whyItMatters: A useful product explanation helps another person identify the object, operate it safely, and decide whether it fits their needs.

mentalModel.title: Identify, operate, evaluate
mentalModel.content: Name the object and purpose, explain the key steps, then assess suitability.

mentalModel.title: Recommendation follows criteria
mentalModel.content: State for whom and under which conditions the product is a good choice.

ruleBlocks.title: Introduce object and purpose
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Das ist ein Gerät, mit dem ...' and name the intended task.

ruleBlocks.title: Explain only essential controls
ruleBlocks.content: Use sequence markers and precise actions.

ruleBlocks.title: Add a basic troubleshooting branch
ruleBlocks.content: State the symptom, likely check, and safe next step.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect recommendation to user profile
ruleBlocks.content: Name benefits, limitations, and the relevant need.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Das ist ein Gerät, mit dem man ...

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies parts, qualities, and evaluation criteria.
Relative clauses make explanations compact and precise.

examples.de: Das ist ein Filter, mit dem man Leitungswasser reinigen kann.
examples.en: This is a filter used to clean tap water.

examples.de: Zuerst setzt man den Behälter ein, anschließend wählt man das Programm.
examples.en: First insert the container, then select the program.

examples.de: Falls das Gerät nicht startet, überprüfen Sie den Anschluss und den Akku.
examples.en: If the device does not start, check the connection and battery.

examples.de: Ich würde das Modell Personen empfehlen, denen ein geringes Gewicht wichtig ist.
examples.en: I would recommend the model to people for whom low weight is important.

examples.de: Für den täglichen professionellen Einsatz ist es weniger geeignet.
examples.en: It is less suitable for daily professional use.

commonMistakes.reason: The listener needs an operational model.

commonMistakes.correct: State the target user and important tradeoffs.

commonMistakes.wrong: Suggest opening or repairing unsafe components.
commonMistakes.correct: Limit troubleshooting to safe checks and professional service.

tips: Explain a familiar object without naming it.
Use no more than five operational steps.
End with ideal user and main limitation.
